October 23, 2025 - Getting to a point where she could pay herself required Susan to seek financing to grow her Boppy inventory. After quitting her job, exhausting all savings, and not qualifying for a bank loan for her start-up, Susan contacted the US Small Business Administration office in Denver about a new microloan program administered by Colorado Enterprise Fund (CEF). The loan Susan got from CEF allowed her to buy the materials she needed to make more products for an international trade event where she won “Best of Show” and secured her first big order.
